description: Health of the Mimir instance itself: ingest, query, TSDB, object storage, ruler/alertmanager and process resources. Built against Mimir 2.16 in monolithic mode as deployed on the playground monitoring host.

panels.description: Series that received a sample within the active-series idle timeout.
panels.title: Active Series

panels.description: Samples/s accepted by the distributor (after relabelling, dedup and validation).
panels.title: Ingestion Rate

panels.description: Requests/s across all Prometheus query API routes.
panels.title: Read QPS

panels.description: TSDB blocks currently in object storage (bucket index).
panels.title: Blocks in Bucket

panels.description: Failed rule evaluations plus missed rule-group iterations over the last hour.
panels.title: Rule Eval Failures (1h)

panels.description: HTTP status of /api/v1/push. 499 = client closed connection; 5xx = server-side failure.
panels.title: Remote-Write Requests /s by Status

panels.description: Samples rejected by validation or limits (rate limit, out-of-order, too old, per-series limits...). Empty = nothing discarded.
panels.title: Discarded Samples /s by Reason

panels.description: Time since the distributor last received any sample. Should stay near the fleet scrape interval (~1m); a climbing value means remote-write from the alloy agents has stopped.
panels.title: Age of Most Recent Sample

panels.description: A persistently non-zero queue means queriers can't keep up with incoming queries.
panels.title: Query-Frontend Queue

panels.description: Query-frontend results cache. Only range queries spanning multiple splits are cacheable.
panels.title: Query Result Cache Hit Ratio

panels.description: Series and chunks fetched from ingesters + store-gateway to answer queries. Sudden growth usually means an expensive dashboard or rule.
panels.title: Data Touched by Queries /s

panels.description: Queries refused by limits (chunk/series/data fetch limits, queue full...). Empty = none rejected.
panels.title: Rejected / Discarded Queries /s

panels.description: In-memory = series in the TSDB head (kept until 2h block cut + head GC). Active = received a sample recently. A large gap means high churn.
panels.title: Series in Memory

panels.description: Persistent creation without matching removal (outside head GC cycles) = cardinality growth.
panels.title: Series Churn /s

panels.description: Any non-zero value here indicates local TSDB trouble (disk, corruption). Expected empty.
panels.title: TSDB Failures /s

panels.description: Head compaction cuts a 2h block from the in-memory head; expect a blip every 2 hours.
panels.title: TSDB Head Compactions /s

panels.description: Ingester ships each 2h block to the bucket. Sustained values above ~3h mean uploads are failing (check cortex_ingester_shipper_upload_failures_total).
panels.title: Age of Last Shipped Block

panels.description: Steadily growing 'blocks' with no compaction/cleanup, or lingering partials, indicate compactor problems.
panels.title: Bucket Blocks

panels.description: Compaction runs on an interval (see cortex_compactor_compaction_interval_seconds). Ages that keep climbing past the interval mean the compactor is stuck.
panels.title: Compactor: Age of Last Successful Run

panels.description: Failed S3 operations by Mimir component. Expected empty.
panels.title: Object Store Failures /s

panels.description: Blocks the store-gateway keeps index-headers loaded for, to serve long-range queries.
panels.title: Store-Gateway Blocks

panels.description: Missed iterations mean rule groups take longer to evaluate than their interval.
panels.title: Rule Evaluations /s

panels.description: If the slowest group approaches its interval, evaluations start getting missed.
panels.title: Rule Group Evaluation Duration

panels.description: Failures of the ruler writing recording-rule results back or querying for rule evaluation. Expected empty.
panels.title: Ruler Failures /s

panels.description: Whether the ruler successfully loaded its rule configuration last time.
panels.title: Ruler Config Load

panels.description: Whether the alertmanager successfully loaded its configuration last time.
panels.title: Alertmanager Config Load

panels.description: CPU cores consumed by the Mimir process.
panels.title: CPU Usage

title: Mimir Health
